[SWS_DM_00373] Support of
UDS
service ReadDTCInformation, Subfunction
0x18
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04180, RS_Diag_04157, RS_Diag_04067
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall support Subfunction 0x18 (re-
portUserDefMemoryDTCSnapshotRecordByDTCNumber) of the UDS service
0x19 ReadDTCInformation according to ISO 14229-1[1], provided the con-
figuration contains a
DiagnosticReadDTCInformation
of
category
’RE-
PORT_USER_DEF_MEMORY_DTC_SNAPSHOT_RECORD_BY_DTC_NUMBER’.
⌋
